description: This file defines the OrganizationDao class which provides data access methods for the Organization entity within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions to retrieve and save organization general information, handle transactions, and update organizational structure elements.

classes.name: OrganizationDao
classes.description: Data access object class for managing Organization entities, includes methods for retrieving and updating organization information, and internal structure modification.

methods.name: getOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Fetches the organization entity with id 1, acting as a general info getter.

methods.name: saveOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Saves the provided Organization object, handling transactions and exceptions.

methods.name: updateOrganizationStructure
methods.description: Updates the organizational structure by setting the name of the base unit based on the organization name.
